Grok 4.6

Grok 4.6 is the upcoming artificial intelligence model developed by Elon Musk’s xAI. Positioned as the direct successor to Grok 4.5, it represents a significant evolution in xAI's rapid development cycle. Musk officially confirmed the model's existence and scale in late July 2026, stating that the initial pretraining phase was completed around the week of July 20, 2026.[1][2][3]

 Model Scale and Architecture

Initially, there was speculation and early reporting suggesting that Grok 4.6 would be a massive 2trillionparameter model aimed at directly competing with Moonshot AI's 2.8trillionparameter Kimi K3. However, Elon Musk clarified the model's specifications in late July 2026, stating that Grok 4.6 will maintain the 1.5 trillionparameter scale of its predecessor, Grok 4.5.[4][5][6][7][3][1]

Rather than a substantial increase in raw size, Grok 4.6 focuses heavily on posttraining improvements. The core architecture remains similar to the V9 foundation used in Grok 4.5, but the new version incorporates significantly enhanced supervised finetuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL). This approach is designed to deliver a more capable and robust model without sacrificing the inference economics—specifically, the high serving speed and token efficiency—that characterized Grok 4.5.[8][6][7][3][4][1]

 Release Timeline

The release schedule for xAI's upcoming models is notably aggressive. Elon Musk initially stated that Grok 4.6 would be launched around August 7, 2026, roughly two weeks after his lateJuly announcement. This release is expected to be closely followed by Grok 4.7, a larger 2.1trillionparameter model, which is slated to arrive just a few weeks after Grok 4.6. Despite the targeted August 7 release date for Grok 4.6, as of that date, the model had not yet been officially released to the public.[7][3][9][10][8]

When released, Grok 4.6 is anticipated to be available through the xAI API via the developer console, as well as integrated into the Grok app and X Premium+. However, xAI has not yet released official documentation detailing the model's full specifications, benchmarks, or pricing structure.[6][11]
